meaning:
1) a small thing
1a) small thing
1b) little while (of time)

elsewhere.note: See now, this city is near to flee to, and it is a little one. Oh let me escape there (isn’t it a little one?), and my soul will live.”
For the army of the Syrians came with a small company of men; and Yahweh delivered a very great army into their hand, because they had forsaken Yahweh, the God…
Though your beginning was small, yet your latter end would greatly increase.
Your holy people possessed it but a little while. Our adversaries have trodden down your sanctuary.
